column2: I just got word from the client, the packages arrived safely!
Thanks for getting it done on time. I'll send some cash your way.
The client said he hasn't received the package yet.
Please hurry and get it delivered!
On my way!
I won't make it on time.
Thanks.
Seriously?
Hey, thanks for reaching out.
It's a bit urgent, I need some packages delivered to a client as soon as possible.
Are you up for the job? I'll be paying you, of course.
Sure, I'll do it.
Don't have time for it.
Thanks! Make sure to call back as soon as you deliver the packages so I can tell the client to get them.
Sent the location list over your way. I'm counting on you!
Alright then, your loss.
Look, I appreciate you taking the job, but you took way too long.
The client couldn't wait any longer.
If you can't deliver on time, please don't take the job.
I think I got the wrong number. Sorry.
